topic.title: Telecommunications Infrastructure / Code Operators / Prior Approval
topic.source_contract: operator and code status, coverage and capacity need, site selection and sharing, apparatus design, permitted-development or planning route, consultation, ICNIRP declaration, prior approval, installation, commissioning and live-service evidence

scope_guards: A predicted coverage map is not treated as live measured service.
Code-operator status is not treated as landowner agreement.
A prior notification is not treated as prior approval.
Prior approval is not treated as installed infrastructure.
An ICNIRP declaration is not treated as commissioning evidence.
Installed equipment is not treated as connected to power and backhaul.
A live signal is not treated as sustained capacity performance.
No score or promotion is written without exact rights, consent, installation, commissioning and measured service evidence.
